comparison.objective: Shake an inverted separatory funnel to mix two layers, periodically vent it, and return it to its support.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual vessel inversion, repeated shaking, stopcock operation, pressure management, and careful replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Complete the required strokes without pressure blowout or low-stem venting, then replace the closed, stopped funnel and release it.
comparison.reason: Both involve controlled agitation and returning a vessel to a support, but PR-1156 agitates to mix and tests periodic venting. The candidate agitates to make selected free bodies pass through real holes while retaining others; that selective many-body separation is meaningfully different.
